d: At least seven people, including a driver, have been killed and 112 injured after two trains collided in Egypt's al-Ayyat, south of Giza. According to the country's health ministry, injured passengers are being treated at three hospitals near the crash site. More than 70 ambulances were dispatched as emergency teams responded to the disaster. Egypt's Public Prosecution Office said a train travelling from Giza to Fayoum collided with the rear of a service heading from Cairo to Aswan, believed to have been stationary.
